description: This file defines the Tiny YOLOv3 neural network model class, including its layers, forward pass, and related methods, for object detection tasks.

classes.name: YoloV3Tiny
classes.description: A PyTorch neural network module implementing the Tiny YOLOv3 architecture for object detection.

methods.name: get_loss_layers
methods.description: Returns the detection layers used for computing loss during training.

methods.name: __route_layer
methods.description: Concatenates two feature maps along the channel dimension, used internally for route layers.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Defines the forward pass of the network, processing input images to produce detection outputs.
